title: The Wobbly Shadow Star
markdown:
The sun painted the kitchen gold! Rafi’s eyes popped open. Today felt special! His tummy did a flip-flop with excitement.

Plum the rabbit thumped her foot. Thump! Thump! “Rafi! Come see!” she squeaked.

Rafi dashed downstairs. “What is it, Plum?”

Plum poked her head out. “Look!” A bright yellow chalk star sat by the big oak tree. But the tree’s long shadow was creeping over it!

“The star is going away!” Rafi gasped. “It’s walking!”

Mr. Reed came out. “What’s the fuss?”

“The star is disappearing!” Rafi pointed.

Mr. Reed chuckled. “It’s not the star, Rafi. It’s the tree’s shadow traveling!”

“A shadow?” Plum wiggled her nose. “What’s a shadow?”

“A shadow happens when something blocks the sun,” Mr. Reed explained. “It’s a dark shape. The sun moves across the sky, like a giant flashlight. The tree blocks the sun. So, it makes a shadow!”

Mr. Reed stuck a stick in the ground. Plink! A shadow appeared. “See? The stick blocks the light. That’s its shadow.” He waited. The shadow stretched longer. “The sun is moving up, so the shadow moves!”

Rafi’s eyes sparkled. “I get it! The sun is like a giant painter! The tree is like a brush, and the shadows are paint strokes moving across the ground!”

Plum bounced. “So the star isn’t walking! The tree’s shadow is just covering it up!”

Rafi grinned. He grabbed blue chalk and drew another star, further away. “Now we wait for the shadow to find my new star!”

They watched. Slowly, the oak tree’s shadow crept across the path, reaching for the blue star. Yes! It did! The shadow covered the new star perfectly.

“Wow!” Plum squeaked. “You figured it out!”

“Shadows happen when light is blocked. They move when the sun moves!” Mr. Reed beamed.

Rafi jumped up, buzzing with excitement. “Today,” he declared, “is going to be AMAZING!” And with a grin as wide as the sky, he raced out the door, ready for whatever new wonders the day might bring!
characters: Rafi the question asker, Plum the rabbit, Mr. Reed
